rule.criterion: The childhood-memory description consists of a single sentence; handle abbreviations and quotes semantically.

questions: Describe a special memory from your childhood in a single sentence.

A.text: One summer evening, I sat on the porch swing with my grandfather, listening to the crickets and watching the stars twinkle above as he told me stories about the night sky.

B.text: One summer evening, I sat on the porch swing with my grandfather, listening to the crickets and sharing stories under the glow of the setting sun.

C.text: One summer evening, I sat cross-legged on the porch steps, watching fireflies dance in the twilight, as my grandfather told me stories under the stars.

D.text: One summer evening, I sat cross-legged on the porch steps, watching fireflies dance in the twilight, as my grandfather told me stories under the stars.
